reading.action: Retrieve the winding-drum core + warden's chain from the broken Colossus, haul them up through the exit, set them down at the next floor, and quietly scout what lies ahead.

check.note: STRONG read tier (intReconRead_strong). Floor 5 is keyed to his build: Ember affinity = an always-on HEAT-SENSE, reads run off INTELLECT not passive PER. The heatless hearth is the guaranteed tell; margin 23 surfaces the rest — sourceless light / no honest shadows, the host's looping welcome, bones under the cloth-edges, WILL flagging the comfort-pull as foreign. Below the nat-20 meta-read (does not see the whole floor as one woven image).

reading.result: ASCENT + THRESHOLD SCOUT. Hauled the winding-drum core + warden's chain-length up out of the shaft (floor 4 closed). Emerged at the floor-5 threshold into a warm 'haven' — laid table, banked hearth, a hooded host rising in welcome — set the salvage down and read it WITHOUT entering. STRONG read: the hearth throws no heat, the light is sourceless (no honest shadows from hearth/lamps/host while his own body + maul cast theirs), the welcome gesture loops, old bone lies under the table-cloth edges, and his WILL flags the urge-to-rest as pressed in from outside. COSTS: Stamina 50->38 (heavy haul); Focus 89 + HP 124 unchanged. LOOT +winding-drum core, +Warden's chain-length (atk 5; both salvage, keeps Burning Anger). No XP/skill/affinity tick. STOP on the threshold — has NOT stepped in; retreat to floor 4 still open. End on the situation, NOT his choice. NO Tower reset.
